title: Latency regression without errors
objective: Return slow 200 responses; an exceeded journey budget must fail acceptance.
banner: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
preconditions: Modern browser with local JavaScript; no server, account or framework
Three fixed synthetic attempted canary journeys per independent rehearsal, all labelled HTTP 200
The synthetic starting canary is 25%; the inclusive journey budget is declared before the decision
actions: Choose a slow, compliant or unmeasured fixed trace and a 1000 or 1500 ms budget
Request expansion or hold/reject the candidate, then inspect acceptance, decision verifier and journey counts
Reset the current rehearsal using mouse or keyboard; retain all previous outcomes and budgets

syntheticInputs.historyLifetime: In-memory page session; current-rehearsal reset preserves history and the fixed allowance

expectedAssertions: Any exceeded journey budget produces failed candidate acceptance and blocks expansion despite HTTP 200
Safe rejection may pass the decision verifier but never relabels interrupted journeys as successes
Complete compliant latency, including equality at the budget, permits only synthetic requested expansion
Missing latency is unknown, blocks expansion and remains in the attempted denominator
Success + interruption + unknown equals all retained attempted journeys, including earlier failures after reset
Invalid input, altered state, duplicate decisions and excess attempts cannot append a false result
Keyboard controls, explicit error focus, reset and enforced CSP work in the actual isolated browser DOM
limits: All HTTP statuses, durations, fault actions and routing values are fixed synthetic data; no server or load generation
No actual HTTP, latency, user-journey acceptance, native Azure, parent-demo or reliability certification
IaC N/A; no cloud, identity, credentials, deployment, spend, packages, framework or shared-root changes
Existing Node 22 test tooling, offline Playwright 1.56.1 and signed Edge 156 only; not production Node 24
Read-only verification by default; CAPTURE_BROWSER_EVIDENCE=1 is deliberate capture only
Only published isolated.cjs 53c0c0d with SHA256 86c80bc2ce52f828a96b176056706c60970be4367b085dc0919d3bfce86cc055; no abandoned lifecycle prototype

acceptance.workerResult: Worker verification and publication are separate from parent-owned empirical acceptance
acceptance.credit: At most one A-S093 frozen S unit; tests, evidence and tooling earn no extra credit
